title: Move carbs out of your drag window.
subtitle: Meal composition
rationale: Shift carbohydrate intake away from the work or evening window where your recorded response is weaker.

evidence.summary: The metabolic response to carbohydrate intake differs by time of day.

indications: Focus drops after carbohydrate-heavy meals during work hours.
Evening carbohydrate loads precede poorer sleep or next-morning grogginess.
